description:
Search nodes in a CoreModels project. Returns compact positional arrays; the response "format" field describes the layout.

Filters (provide at least one of the first three; they combine with AND):
- nodeIds: exact id lookup
- nodeType: one of Element, Type, Taxonomy, Exemplar, Component, Space, Tag, Mixin
- expression: partial substring match on the node label (plain text, no wildcards)
- spaceIds: restrict results to specific spaces. Narrowing only - cannot be the sole filter; always combine it with nodeIds, nodeType, or expression.

Optional flags: includeRelations, includeMixins, includeTimestamps, sortAttr, sortDesc, pageSize.

Pagination:
- Page-number based: pass page (1-based) and pageSize (max 250).
- The response includes the total match count, so more pages exist while page * pageSize < total.

expression.description: Partial substring match against the node label. Plain text only - no wildcards, no regex, no '*', '%', '_' or '?' characters; the literal characters are matched as-is.

includeTimestamps.description: Adds creationTime and updateTime (ISO 8601 UTC) to each node. Combine with sortAttr CreationTime/UpdateTime to see when nodes changed.

limitPerRelationGroup.description: Only with includeRelations. Caps relations returned PER relation group for each node (e.g. 100). Omit for no cap.

page.description: 1-based page number. The response includes 'total' (the total match count) so you can compute how many pages there are.
